milestones.title: Few-Shot Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning is Better and Cheaper than In-Context Learning
milestones.why: It argued that parameter-efficient fine-tuning beats ICL on both accuracy and cost.
milestones.workTitle: Few-Shot Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning is Better and Cheaper than In-Context Learning

evidence.text: Few-shot in-context learning (ICL) enables pre-trained language models to perform a previously-unseen task without any gradient-based training by feeding a small number of training examples as part of the input.
evidence.title: Few-Shot Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning is Better and Cheaper than In-Context Learning

evidence.title: Few-shot Fine-tuning vs. In-context Learning: A Fair Comparison and Evaluation

milestones.title: In-context Learning and Induction Heads
milestones.why: It recast ICL broadly as decreasing loss at later token positions and tied it to a specific attention mechanism.

evidence.text: In this work, we present preliminary and indirect evidence for a hypothesis that induction heads might constitute the mechanism for the majority of all "in-context learning" in large transformer models (i.e. decreasing loss at increasing token indices).
evidence.title: In-context Learning and Induction Heads

milestones.title: Transformers learn in-context by gradient descent
milestones.why: It reframed ICL as implicit learning algorithms, such as gradient descent, running inside transformers, a framing that later works followed.
milestones.workTitle: Transformers learn in-context by gradient descent

evidence.text: At present, the mechanisms of in-context learning in Transformers are not well understood and remain mostly an intuition.
evidence.title: Transformers learn in-context by gradient descent

evidence.text: Neural sequence models, especially transformers, exhibit a remarkable capacity for in-context learning.
evidence.title: What learning algorithm is in-context learning? Investigations with linear models

evidence.text: In-context learning refers to the ability of a model to condition on a prompt sequence consisting of in-context examples (input-output pairs corresponding to some task) along with a new query input, and generate the corresponding output.
evidence.title: What Can Transformers Learn In-Context? a Case Study of Simple Function Classes

evidence.title: Why Can GPT Learn In-Context? Language Models Secretly Perform Gradient Descent as Meta-Optimizers

evidence.title: Transformers learn to implement preconditioned gradient descent for in-context learning

milestones.title: TabPFN: A Transformer That Solves Small Tabular Classification Problems in a Second
milestones.why: It brought ICL to tabular prediction, which later produced tabular foundation models.
milestones.workTitle: TabPFN: A Transformer That Solves Small Tabular Classification Problems in a Second

evidence.text: TabPFN performs in-context learning (ICL), it learns to make predictions using sequences of labeled examples (x, f(x)) given in the input, without requiring further parameter updates.
evidence.title: TabPFN: A Transformer That Solves Small Tabular Classification Problems in a Second

evidence.text: Since the seminal work of TabPFN, research on tabular foundation models (TFMs) based on in-context learning (ICL) has challenged long-standing paradigms in machine learning.
evidence.title: Mitra: Mixed Synthetic Priors for Enhancing Tabular Foundation Models

evidence.text: Tabular foundation models, such as TabPFNv2 and TabICL, have recently dethroned gradient-boosted trees at the top of predictive benchmarks, demonstrating the value of in-context learning for tabular data.
evidence.title: TabICLv2: A better, faster, scalable, and open tabular foundation model

milestones.title: A Survey on In-context Learning
milestones.why: This highly cited survey consolidated ICL as a new paradigm for NLP.

evidence.text: With the increasing capabilities of large language models (LLMs), in-context learning (ICL) has emerged as a new paradigm for natural language processing (NLP), where LLMs make predictions based on contexts augmented with a few examples.
evidence.title: A Survey on In-context Learning

evidence.text: A Survey on In-context Learning
evidence.title: A Survey on In-context Learning

milestones.title: Neural Codec Language Models are Zero-Shot Text to Speech Synthesizers
milestones.why: It extended ICL to speech synthesis, where a short acoustic prompt serves as the context.
milestones.workTitle: Neural Codec Language Models are Zero-Shot Text to Speech Synthesizers

evidence.text: Vall-E emerges in-context learning capabilities and can be used to synthesize high-quality personalized speech with only a 3-second enrolled recording of an unseen speaker as an acoustic prompt.
evidence.title: Neural Codec Language Models are Zero-Shot Text to Speech Synthesizers

evidence.text: VALL-E X inherits strong in-context learning capabilities and can be applied for zero-shot cross-lingual text-to-speech synthesis and zero-shot speech-to-speech translation tasks.
evidence.title: Speak Foreign Languages with Your Own Voice: Cross-Lingual Neural Codec Language Modeling

evidence.text: Seed-TTS serves as a foundation model for speech generation and excels in speech in-context learning, achieving performance in speaker similarity and naturalness that matches ground truth human speech in both objective and subjective evaluations.
evidence.title: Seed-TTS: A Family of High-Quality Versatile Speech Generation Models

milestones.title: Images Speak in Images: A Generalist Painter for In-Context Visual Learning
milestones.why: It carried the NLP ICL paradigm over to vision tasks.
milestones.workTitle: Images Speak in Images: A Generalist Painter for In-Context Visual Learning

evidence.text: In-context learning, as a new paradigm in NLP, allows the model to rapidly adapt to various tasks with only a handful of prompts and examples.
evidence.title: Images Speak in Images: A Generalist Painter for In-Context Visual Learning

evidence.text: In this paper, the main focus is on an emergent ability in large vision models, known as in-context learning, which allows inference on unseen tasks by conditioning on in-context examples (a.k.a.~prompt) without updating the model parameters.
evidence.title: What Makes Good Examples for Visual In-Context Learning?

evidence.text: We unify various segmentation tasks into a generalist in-context learning framework that accommodates different kinds of segmentation data by transforming them into the same format of images.
evidence.title: SegGPT: Towards Segmenting Everything In Context
